transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi, nice to meet you too. Well, I guess what finally got me in here is... over these last few months, my mind just keeps jumping around. 

I drive a truck for a living, and lately, it's like every little thing pulls my attention away. Every time the CB radio chirps, or I pass a fuel price sign, or I just get some new idea in my head, I get completely sidetracked. And because of that, I'm starting to miss details that I normally never miss. Things like messing up a client’s delivery note or completely forgetting who I promised to call back. It's just starting to cause some real issues for me at work, so I figured I needed to come in.
When you were a child, did you also have a hard time paying attention or staying focused?

No, not that I can remember. I mean, school was just school, but I never had any real trouble paying attention back then. I could sit still and get my work done just fine. This whole thing with my mind jumping around... it's really just been happening lately, like over the last few months.
Have you had a period when you felt unusually energized or wired, much more than your normal self?

Yeah, actually, I have. Lately, I've just been... going non-stop. I keep finding all these extra jobs for myself. Like, I'll spend hours rewriting my route plans to make them perfect, or I'll stay up late checking in on the new drivers after hours when I should be resting. And even when I get home, I'm fixing things around the house that don't even really need fixing right now. I just... I feel really antsy if I try to sit still for too long. It's like I have to keep moving.
During this time, have you been needing less sleep than usual?

Yeah, definitely. Most nights lately, I'm only getting maybe three or four hours of sleep. And the weird thing is, I'm not even tired. I wake up before the sun's even out, and I just feel... ready to roll. Normally, running on that little sleep would have me completely worn out behind the wheel, but right now, I just get up and get going.
During these past few months, have you felt unusually euphoric or unusually irritable compared with your normal self?

Yeah, I'd say so. For months now, I've just been... I don't know, either way too fired up, like I'm on top of the world and everything's just gonna work out perfectly no matter what I do, or... or I'm just snapping at people. Like, over really small stuff at home or when I'm out working in the yard. It's just not my usual way of being. I'm normally a pretty even-keeled guy, but lately, it's just one extreme or the other.
During this time, have you heard or seen things that other people said were not there?
No, I haven't had anything like that. I haven't seen or heard anything that wasn't there. It's just the energy and the mood stuff, really.
Have you felt unusually powerful or important lately, like you could do things most people couldn’t?

Yeah, I guess I have had some of that. Recently, I just... I got it in my head that I could rebuild the whole driver training program at work all by myself. I was convinced I could make it run way better than the bosses ever could. Which is funny looking back, because that’s not really my lane at all—I'm just a driver. But at the time, I really felt like I had all the answers and could just take over and fix everything they were doing wrong.
Have you had any new medical illness or head injury around the time these symptoms started?
No, nothing like that. I haven't been sick with anything new, and... well, no, I definitely haven't hit my head or been in any accidents. Physically, I've been perfectly healthy.
